definitions.explanation: A local government office in charge of public health: infectious disease control, food hygiene inspections, health checkups and related services.

examples.japanese: {保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted the public health center.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{要|い}る→要る：09589_iru⟧。
examples.english: You need a permit from the health center to open a restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じた→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧。
examples.english: Because of a food poisoning outbreak, the health center ordered the restaurant to suspend business.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Prefectures and large cities run {保健所|ほけんじょ}. Besides disease control and restaurant inspections, they handle infant checkups, mental health consultations and stray dogs, and the word became familiar to everyone during the COVID-19 pandemic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}る→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧: to report to the health center
- {保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧: guidance from the health center
- {保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}り→立ち入り：10671_tachiiri⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: an on-site inspection by the health center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{保健室|ほけんしつ}→保健室：05380_hokenshitsu⟧: a school's nurse's office
- ⟦{保健|ほけん}→保健：11616_hoken⟧⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧: a municipal health center for checkups and consultations
